2608.18613.title: CTIFoundry: An Agent-Native Corpus Scaffold for Cyber Threat Intelligence
2608.18613.paper_summary: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is increasingly consumed not by human analysts but by LLM agents that compose multi-step investigations at query time. The harness side of this shift has matured rapidly (planning loops, tool protocols, context management), but the corpus side has not: threat reports and vulnerability databases are still packaged for retrieval-augmented generation, as opaque chunks behind an embedding index. We argue that this substrate, not model capability, is the bottleneck on agentic CTI investigation, and present CTIFoundry, an agent-native corpus scaffold. At build time, CTIFoundry materializes the latent structure of a CTI corpus: a deterministic ontology graph over four authoritative knowledge bases (CVE, CWE, CAPEC, ATT&CK) whose official cross-references become typed, traversable edges; a span-grounded report layer whose canonical, alias-resolved cross-vendor entities index provenance-carrying chunks; and hybrid dense+lexical retrieval surfaces. At query time this structure is exposed through seven typed tools and three procedural skills mounted on a stock open-source agent harness. On the public CTIConnect benchmark, swapping only the action surface lifts the identically-harnessed agent by +0.19 to +0.28 overall F1 across a four-model, two-provider panel: a small model on CTIFoundry surpasses a flagship on the flat substrate, and the gain is not bought with search effort, since on both Claude models the scaffolded agent is more accurate at roughly half the tool calls. An ablation attributes it: typed structure carries the larger share, procedural skills convert structure into discipline, and the two compose super-additively, because skills bind only to structure that exists.
2608.18613.paper_summary_zh: 網路威脅情報（CTI）越來越多地被大型語言模型（LLM）代理消耗，而不是人類分析師，這些代理在查詢時組成多步調查。這一轉變的利用面迅速成熟（計畫循環、工具協議、上下文管理），但其語料庫面卻未能跟上：威脅報告和漏洞數據庫仍然以檢索增強生成的形式包裝，作為嵌入索引後的不透明塊。我們認為，這一基礎結構，而非模型能力，是代理CTI調查的瓶頸，並提出CTIFoundry，一個代理原生的語料庫框架。在構建時，CTIFoundry實現了CTI語料庫的潛在結構：一個基於四個權威知識庫（CVE、CWE、CAPEC、ATT&CK）的確定性本體圖，其官方交叉引用成為類型化的、可遍歷的邊緣；一個基於跨度的報告層，其標準化、別名解析的跨供應商實體索引承載來源的塊；以及混合的密集+詞彙檢索表面。在查詢時，這一結構通過七個類型化工具和三個程序技能在一個標準的開源代理框架上暴露。在公共CTIConnect基準測試中，僅更換行動表面就使得同樣框架的代理整體F1提升了+0.19到+0.28，涵蓋四個模型、兩個提供者的面板：CTIFoundry上的小型模型超越了平面基礎上的旗艦模型，且這一增益並未以搜索努力為代價，因為在兩個Claude模型上，搭建的代理在大約一半的工具調用中更為準確。一項消融實驗將其歸因於：類型化結構承擔了更大的份額，程序技能將結構轉化為紀律，兩者超加性地組合，因為技能僅綁定於已存在的結構。
